profile.headline: Engineering Leader | Data Platforms, ML Infrastructure, & Backend Systems | Spark, Kafka, AWS | Java, Python
profile.summary:
I’m a technical leader, software architect, and server side developer with deep experience building scalable data platforms, back end services, and ML serving infrastructure. Over my career, I’ve led teams and developed systems that power analytics, recommendations, and decision support across large organizations and startups alike.

My background includes expertise in data processing at scale (Apache Spark, Trino), event-driven systems (Kafka), cloud platforms (AWS), and ML model deployment. I thrive in roles that bridge strategy and execution, whether as a team leader or hands-on writing production code.

I hold a Ph.D. in Operations Research from UC Berkeley and have a strong foundation in optimization, scheduling, and simulation. I'm passionate about building systems that deliver measurable business value and supporting engineering teams as they grow.

positions.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on our next generation billing platform, moving to a more modern tech stack.  Initially focusing on fraud and other initiatives as we ramp up traffic to the new platform.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Docker · Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) · PostgreSQL · Apache Kafka

positions.title: Director, Data Platform
positions.description:
Led two cross-functional teams supporting Stitch Fix’s analytics-focused data platform, serving ~100 data scientists and numerous business users. One team focused on data infrastructure (querying, ingestion, orchestration); the other on machine learning enablement (model serving, feature store).  Key responsibilities and achievements:
 - Directed the evolution of the data platform organization, defining team charters and technical scope.
 - Owned infrastructure for data querying and metadata (Spark, Trino, Druid, Hive Metastore, custom Python clients, and supporting libraries).
 - Oversaw job orchestration via a homegrown Airflow-based system and EKS-based execution.
 - Led ML deployment infrastructure for online and offline recommendations and optimization.
 - Managed ingestion from Kafka, production database snapshots, and external vendors.
 - Consolidated redundant services and enhanced system observability and monitoring.
 - Mentored a new manager and helped shape the long-term strategy for the platform organization.

positions.title: Data Platform Manager and Engineer
positions.description:
Joined as an individual contributor on the Platform Team and became a hands-on manager of the Compute Infrastructure Team. Led efforts to build scalable, cloud-native systems for data ingestion, processing, and querying.   Key projects and contributions:
 - Scaled Apache Spark workloads and improved reliability, supporting thousands of daily jobs.
 - Moved Spark workloads from Amazon EMR to EMR on EKS, simplifying cluster maintenance.
 - Operated and tuned Trino clusters, including one for Looker BI and another for data science and engineering workloads.
 - Led adoption of Apache Kafka for business event and application logging, and later led the migration from self-managed clusters to AWS MSK.
 - Developed microservices for metadata management, data exploration, and Python-based utilities for single-table reads/writes for convenient use in data science workloads.
 - Collaborated with data engineering to deliver Python clients for data querying, job execution, and metadata management.
 - Implemented services and pipelines for GDPR compliance to limit personal data ingestion and support customer data erasure from the data warehouse.
 - Grew the team from 2 to 6 engineers, hired and mentored team members, and provided stability through multiple organization changes.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Led architecture and server-side development for full-stack extensions to the Mobile Banking platform, delivering new customer-facing services for partner banks.
 - Designed reusable frameworks and enforced best practices for backend development.
 - Built a self-service portal for banks to manage in-app promotions and configurations.
 - Used Amazon S3 for asset storage and helped evaluate JBoss Fuse for future server architecture.

Technical environment : Java, JBOSS, SOAP, REST, AWS, SSL, HTML5, JavaScript, JQuery Mobile

Note: initially joined mFoundry in 2012, acquired by FIS in 2013.

company.name: mFoundry and Fidelity National Information Services

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to Brighterion’s fraud detection platform, enhancing server-side systems for transaction processing and behavioral data profiling.  Key projects included:
 - Designed and developed a new server for managing long-term behavioral and profile data.
 - Created a validator for rule sets for fraud detection across financial use cases.
 - Improved inter-server communication, reliability, and failover through custom messaging tools and improvements to server mirroring.

positions.title: Director, Platform Software Group
positions.description:
Started as a consultant at Sapias and transitioned to full-time, continuing under Wireless Matrix after its acquisition of Sapias in 2007. Held both leadership and development roles focused on backend systems supporting Fleet Management and Automatic Vehicle Location (AVL).

Key highlights of this position:
 - Led a backend engineering team maintaining high-volume systems processing millions of AVL (vehicle location) messages daily.
 - Delivered scalable messaging infrastructure and web services for integration with external workforce systems.
 - Re-architected message processing pipelines using JMS for improved performance.
Implemented a two-way messaging system with in-vehicle navigation devices.
 - Managed hiring, team mentoring, and agile development cycles.

Technical Environment: Java, Spring, Hibernate, JMS, XML, Web Services, Tomcat, WebLogic, C++, ILOG Dispatcher, JNI, Maven and Ant

positions.title: Lead Software Application Engineer
positions.description:
Key highlights of this position:
 - Designed a field service scheduling and routing application using ILOG Dispatcher (constraint programming) and made improvements based on customer requests.
 - Enhanced message processing for new GPS device types and evolving customer requirements.
 - Worked in tandem with consultants on a system redesign to improve reliability and scalability.

Technical environment: Same as other Wireless Matrix position.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Worked with clients across industries to design and develop optimization models for planning, scheduling, logistics, and configuration problems using ILOG's Optimization Suite (CPLEX, OPL, Solver, Scheduler, Dispatcher). Engaged in all stages of solution delivery: from mathematical modeling to data integration and software packaging and deployment. Also delivered customer training on optimization APIs.

Selected projects:
 - Designed a column generation model to optimize greeting card layout and print grouping. Developed in OPL and C++, integrated into a Java-based production system.
 - Built a complex production planning, cutting stock, and scheduling model for a paper manufacturer using CPLEX and ILOG Scheduler; integrated with SAP.
 - Developed LP-based (Linear Programming) supply chain planning models for three customers, including two focused on semiconductor manufacturing. Implemented in C++ and Java.
 - Created a real-time product configuration engine for a CRM provider using C++, optimized for performance.
 - Designed a vehicle-routing model for LTL (less-than-truckload) shipping, implemented in C++ and accessed via Java using JNI and XML problem instance data.
 - Built a portfolio scheduling model for consulting resource planning (C++).
 - Developed a consumer loan recommendation engine combining a rules engine (JRules) and constraint programming (JSolver) in a J2EE architecture.
 - Created a mortgage loan configuration engine reflecting complex rate policies and consolidation options using ILOG JConfigurator and Java.
 - Built an exam and audit scheduling model for a financial exchange using ILOG Scheduler and Java.

Technical environments (varied across projects): C++, Java, JNI, XML, SQL, HTML, JavaScript

positions.title: Early Career and Academic Projects
positions.description:
𝗚𝗿𝗮𝗱𝘂𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗵 & 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁𝘀 – UC Berkeley & Industry Collaborations
While pursuing Ph.D. and M.S. degrees in Operations Research at UC Berkeley, worked on applied mathematical optimization and modeling projects with industry partners:
 - General Motors Research (1997): Modeled waste flows and energy use in manufacturing systems.
 - IBM Systems Storage Division (1994-95): Enhanced disk drive head manufacturing simulations.
 - Berkeley Consortium on Green Design (1996-98): Developed process selection and optimization tools for sustainable manufacturing.
- Served as teaching assistant for undergraduate courses; received excellent student evaluations.

𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘀𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁, 𝗔𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗲𝗻 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘀𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 (𝗻𝗼𝘄 𝗔𝗰𝗰𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲) – San Francisco, CA. 1992 - 1993
Worked on design and implementation of enterprise information systems for a major telecommunications company.
 - Helped build a billing system using SQL in a DB2 environment.
 - Performed systems programming and trained new hires.
